aliases: Ce-decorated NiFe LDH nanosheets array anchored on vertically aligned CuO nanowire

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM shows vertically aligned CuO nanowires on copper foam, with CeNiFe LDH forming a core-shell structure (~10 μm length, 400 nm diameter).
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in the scanning electron microscopy (SEM) image, the CuO nanowires are vertically aligned on the copper foam surface (Figure 1b), while the Ce-decorated NiFe LDH is uniformly anchored to form a core-shell structure with length of ≈ 10 μm and diameter of 400 nm.

properties.description: Grayscale electron micrograph showing a layered nanoscale material with a porous or fibrous morphology. A denser, brighter horizontal band is visible in the center, flanked by more diffuse or porous regions.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM and HRTEM images reveal a core-shell structure (200 nm CuO core, 100 nm NiFe shell) with lattice fringes of 0.254 nm (NiFe LDH (012)) and 0.33 nm (CeO2 (111)). Ce doping introduces abundant amorphous regions and defects.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The diameter of CuO nanowire substrate is ≈ 200 nm, and the thickness of CeNiFe LDH layer on the outer surface is ≈ 100 nm ... The lattice fringe of 0.254 nm belongs to (012) planes of NiFe LDH (Figure 1d), while the lattice fringe of 0.33 nm is attributed to (111) planes of CeO2. ... introduction of Ce species into the NiFe LDH, the CeNiFe layer exhibits abundant amorphous regions
